assumptions: EXISTENTIAL, NOT UNIVERSAL. One worked case establishes that the scoped-and-inherited form exists; nothing here establishes that every complete-mediation law must take it.

That LPM is representative rather than idiosyncratic is NOT established — DEF-R73-LPM-REPRESENTATIVE is the registered doubt. Its lower monitor (LSM) already existed and was verified; this architecture has none.
The consequence drawn for R7.3 — that the channel catalog is a quantifier domain rather than descriptive coverage — is an ARGUMENT from the citation, not part of the cited result.
attrs.evidence: SRC-BATES-2015-LPM. Linux Provenance Modules states G1 Complete as `the provenance record be gapless in its description of system activity`, scopes it to CONTROLLED DATA TYPES, and discharges it by placing a provenance hook directly beneath each LSM authorization hook and INHERITING LSM's separately verified complete mediation over that type universe. It declares the gap the placement creates — failed access attempts are not recorded — and relocates tamperproofness to secure boot and TPM attestation rather than closing it. SRC-SALTZER-1975-MEDIATION supplies the contrast: `every access to every object must be checked for authority` fixes no universe, and the universe is therefore a hypothesis of the principle rather than a consequence of it. THE CONSEQUENCE FOR R7.3: GPT-5.6 proposed keeping the ten-channel catalog as `descriptive coverage, not the theorem`. Half right. The catalog stops being the theorem — a count of channels was never evidence of closure, and one unmediated read gives none of it. But it does not become descriptive; it becomes THE THEOREM'S QUANTIFIER DOMAIN, and a universal over an under-declared domain is satisfiable by leaving things out of the domain. That is the sixth appearance of this artifact's recurring family, arriving one level above the fifth: R7.2 checked that a verdict was derived and not the derivation's INPUT; a mediation law with an unbound universe would check that every channel is mediated while nothing bounds the domain of `every`.

local_bindings: LPM's `controlled data types` binds to this artifact's ten inference channels: both are the object universe a mediation universal quantifies over
LPM's inheritance-from-LSM binds to the discharge route named in admission_mediation.universe.how_it_would_be_discharged, which this tree cannot take because it has no runtime to reduce to
LPM's relocation of tamperproofness to secure boot and TPM binds to ASM-REMOTE-MODEL-IDENTITY, the residual this artifact already relocates rather than closes
source_assumptions: completeness holds over the declared universe of controlled data types and not outside it
the lower monitor's mediation is independently verified — the inheritance is only as strong as that verification
the trusted computing base is intact; disabling the monitor requires booting a different kernel, detectable by attestation rather than prevented

attrs.prior_art: SRC-BATES-2015-LPM (USENIX Security 2015), SRC-SALTZER-1975-MEDIATION, SRC-ANDERSON-1972-REFMON. Read narrowly, as an existence result about how the property is stated in practice — NOT as a theorem that every mediation law must be scoped, which is not established here.

readjudicated.method: citation_recheck — the cited external result is unchanged and its mapping onto the target still resolves
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: Deliberately an EXISTENCE claim and not a universal. What the literature exhibits is a worked case where completeness is scoped and inherited; whether every complete-mediation law must be is a stronger proposition and nothing here establishes it. The artifact-level consequence is carried separately by MOS-MEDIATION-UNIVERSE-DECLARED, which runs.
attrs.statement: There exist complete-mediation results whose completeness is explicitly relative to a declared object universe and discharged by inheritance from a lower verified monitor, rather than argued over an unbounded domain.
